mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Temperatures are currently at 70 degrees with fair conditions around Verona Community Park. Tonight at 5:50 PM, you can catch a clear 3-minute flyover of the International Space Station, rising in the northwest over Middleton near Verona High School and traveling low near the horizon toward the east northeast.

In city news, Thanksgiving scheduling updates have been released. City offices and the Recycling Center will be closed November 26th and 27th, moving Thursday refuse collection to Friday. Additionally, the city is moving forward on plans for a new Public Works and Utilities facility to handle population growth, featuring sustainable building materials and a new tree nursery.

Looking at the events calendar, Yoga at Insight Wellness is available today. Tomorrow brings Hop Haus Trivia at 6:30 PM. On November 27th, Wisconsin Brewing Company will host an event celebrating 50 years of craft brewing.

In weekly police reports, on Wednesday, November 4th, officers responded to a parking lot accident on East Verona Avenue and arrested a Fitchburg woman for O W I with a child passenger in the vehicle.
Culvers of Verona is open today until 10:00 PM. Today's flavor of the day is Butter Pecan, followed by OREO REESE'S Cheesecake tomorrow.
